identificationModule.officialTitle: Clinical Study to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of IM21 CAR-T Cells in the Treatment of Elderly Patients With Relapsed or Refractory Multiple Myeloma

descriptionModule.detailedDescription: In this study, about 10 patients with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma aged ≥60 years were recruited for IM21 CAR-T cell single transfusion therapy. The safety and tolerability of the treatment were evaluated, and the curative effect was initially observed. The research plan includes five stages: screening stage, cell collection stage, chemotherapy pretreatment stage, infusion stage and follow-up stage.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence of adverse events within 1 month after CAR-T cell infusion
